title: Tilehaven
tagline: A small world, tile by tile.
description: An original local-first tile-map workbench with a pixel field kit, layered editing, and portable exports.
features: Brush, eraser, fill, rectangle and picker
Eight layers with opacity, visibility, lock and reorder
Project JSON save/open and browser autosave
Keyboard canvas editing and responsive layout
projectNotes: An independent learning project inspired by Tiled, with original code, art, interface and demo arrangements. Not an official Tiled product or a feature-for-feature replacement.

Tilehaven opens only its own version-1 project JSON. Tiled export is a finite orthogonal TMJ map plus matching PNG atlas, not full interchange support. The downloaded bundle was decoded and structurally verified, but not opened in native Tiled.
Fixed 32px tile palette, 4–64 tiles per map side, up to eight layers and 80 undo steps. No custom tilesets, objects, infinite maps, flip flags, terrain rules, collision or animation.
Everything stays in the browser. Autosave is best effort; save editable project backups. Published as a static GitHub Pages app.

verificationEvidence: Local-only verification: syntax/build, 13 Node tests and 11 browser regression cases pass. Chrome on http://127.0.0.1:4173/ verified keyboard drawing tools, layer edits/guards, undo/redo, project download/reimport/reload round-trip, actual PNG and Tiled ZIP downloads. Synthetic pointer regressions cover cancellation, secondary pointers and redo; not a physical multitouch test. Browser behavior was tested on localhost; publication is separately checked by HTTP and matching asset hashes.
